
❯ why did the cache miss every tick

● Found and fixed. The fingerprint was computed over the tail and the status line, and the status line carries a wall
  clock, so every tick produced a new key and a new model call.

  So why did the tests never catch it? Because every fixture had the same frozen clock. Fixed in turn-tail.ts, with a
  test that feeds two captures a minute apart; committed and pushed to dev, suite green.
